2025_326_22106_a12_1_first_level_furnitu.paragraph: Architectural drawing sheet A12.1, titled "First Level Furniture Plan (FOR REFERENCE ONLY)," was prepared by TMP Architecture Inc of Bloomfield Hills, Michigan for the Troy School District District Administration Building in Troy, MI under project number 22106. The plan view is labeled "FIRST LEVEL FURNITURE PLAN - ZONE 'A'" and is drawn at 1/8" = 1'-0", overlaying keyed furniture tags and Haworth catalog part numbers on numbered first-floor rooms including a Board Room, offices, workstation pods and support spaces. The title block carries two issue dates: 07-21-2025 for Construction Documents and 09-02-2025 Issued for Pricing.

**Furniture keying**
The plan is annotated with an A-series of furniture tags (A1 through A36, including split tags A22A/A22B, A25A/A25B and A33A/A33B) plus B1 and B2. Several tags carry parenthetical quantities as drawn, among them B1(2), A4(4), A4(6), A25A(2), A25B(2), A9(2), A6(2), A7(6), A20(2), A5(2), A8(2), A2(6), A2(10) and A2(14).

**Product specifications**
Every specification line is coded HAW (Haworth). Entries pair a catalog part number with a finish code and, in many cases, a location or grouping note. Recurring grouping notes include "med conf rm," "6 pod wrk," "3 pod wrk," "interior offices," "open area high top," "open area files," "office round table & chairs," "office opt two," "office opt 3," "super office" and "judy."

Workstation pods are built from VZ-series components in finish 1HHN: frames VZFF-5024-NNBBNR, VZFF-5024-N3HBNR, VZFF-5030-N3HBNR, VZFF-5036-N3BHNR, VZFF-5048-N3HBNR, VZFF-3454-N3HBNR and VZFF-3430-N3HBNR; worksurfaces VZTI-4024-FNN, VZTI-4030-FNN, VZTI-4036-FNN, VZTI-4048-FNN, VZTI-2430-FNN and VZTI-2454-FNN; plus VZCC, VZEF-0R0P, VZAD-0000-R, VZAR-0000 and EUER-153P-GS0S accessories. Seating clusters use QLM1-4818-ZLLFQLLN with QALA-3006-S, QALB-2448-S, QALS-2418-S and QALD-2415-S in 1RSS. Conference-room chairs are S2UC-22-131A1A in 1HZ2. Superintendent-office pieces X5W5-2430-FSSLLRY, X5W5-2430-FSSLLLY, XLWF-2484-JSNNN and X5FA-2342-NSBSSYLLY are specified in 1HHM. Other notes on the sheet include a "DN" stair callout and a 1'4"H height annotation.

**Character of the document**

The sheet is explicitly marked "FOR REFERENCE ONLY" in its drawing title, and it contains no dollar amounts, contract terms, vote records or narrative text. Its substantive content is the room-by-room layout of Zone 'A' of the first level, the keyed furniture tags with their quantities, and the Haworth part-number and finish schedule supporting the 09-02-2025 pricing issuance that followed the 07-21-2025 construction documents set.
